messages:
sanjeev_p: Heads-up 10: incoming SI + HW joint marketplace submission for Nimbus Logistics. Need to lock lead ownership, mapping to CRM account, and ROE (rules of engagement) before we publish. Can partnerships triage?
rachel_k: Putting on my radar. Quick q: is Nimbus pre-seed trial or a paying customer? region?
diego_m: Nimbus has a POC, invoice pending 15k ARR, based in NA. Not yet in any active sales cycle.
sanjeev_p: Ok NA POC < $50k. Proposal: partner-led by default for POC < $100k, unless sales flags strategic priority. We should have a clear 3-step handoff: 1) Partner claim in intake form, 2) KAM credit pre-authorize, 3) Marketplace hold until confirmation.
elle_ops: Recommend adding a hard 72-hour SLA for partners to claim after submission, else it autoswitches to Redwood-claim. Keeps listings from stalling.
rachel_k: +1 SLA. Also require single HW contact and SI named AE before claim. We had messy triage when multiple vendor contacts were listed.
diego_m: Who owns mapping to SFDC? I can take mapping but need initial account ID. If not present, we create a phantom account with tag "marketplace-intake" to avoid duplicates.
sanjeev_p: Diego, please create the phantom if no match and add tags: marketplace:intake, partner:TiltSI, hw:EdgeNova. We'll reconcile later.
marketplace-bot: New marketplace form: https://redwood.app/listings/Nimbus-2026 172654 
metadata: partner=TiltSI, hw=EdgeNova, sku=edge-nimbus-1.
elle_ops: Draft ROE suggestion: 
```
- POC < $100k: Partner-led intake (SI=primary) ; Redwood=co-sell 
- POC >= $100k: Redwood outreach + partner enabled 
- Partner must claim within 72h or claim flips to Redwood 
- Single named SI rep + single HW contact required for listing approval 
- KAM credit pre-approval before any pipeline creation
```
sanjeev_p: That looks good. Add an explicit fallback: if account has existing enterprise contract or exec sponsorship, override to Redwood-led regardless of ARR.
marketplace-bot: Auto-tag suggestion added to intake sheet: suggested_claim=partner, sla=72h.
rachel_k: Action items: 1) Diego create phantom account if needed (diego_m) 2) I will draft the intro template for Nimbus + TiltSI + EdgeNova (rachel_k) 3) Sanjeev will notify sales ops for KAM pre-approval (sanjeev_p) 4) Marketplace to hold publish (elle_ops)
diego_m: Phantom created: SFDC id TMP-9812, tagged. Linking now: https://sales.redwood/t/ TMP-9812.
marketplace-bot: Listing hold placed by elle_ops until partner claim confirmed.
olivia_kam: @sanjeev_p thanks for the heads-up 10. I'll review credit split request; for a POC this small propose 60/40 partner/redwood default, but open to adjust based on SI-owned pipeline contribution.
sanjeev_p: Great. Rachel, please include procurement contact + expected pilot dates in the intro. Also cc: @olivia_kam on the intro. Goal: claim + intro sent within 48h.
rachel_k: Will do, drafting now. Moving intro to thread in 30m.
diego_m: One more ask: require SI to ack they will not directly invoice via marketplace SKU without Redwood being on the order. Prevents orphaned SKUs.
elle_ops: Noted. We'll add a checkbox on the listing form: "SI acknowledges joint ordering with Redwood".
sanjeev_p: Thanks all. We'll iterate the ROE doc in Confluence and then bake rules into the intake form. Closing when intro sent. :rocket:
